title: Fraction of applied moment carried by the rib cage (from IDP-moment slopes)
subcategory: pure moment + follower, rib cage share

quantity.name: rib cage moment share
quantity.definition: 1 - slope_intact/slope_noribs (point estimate, 95% CI); only significant cases reported (flexion at both levels, and extension/LB at T8-T9 not significant)

source.authors: Anderson DE, Mannen EM, Tromp R, Wong BM, Sis HL, Cadel ES, Friis EA, Bouxsein ML
source.sample: human cadaver T1-T12 thoracic spines with rib cage (same specimens as Anderson 2016)

protocol.summary: T1-T12 with rib cage, potted at T1 and T12, upright; pure unconstrained moments 0 to ±5 Nm applied at T1 in displacement control at 1 deg/s, 5 cycles, 3rd cycle analysed; 400 N compressive follower load (cables lateral to spine via rods through each vertebral body); AR, FE, LB; rib cage intact -> stiffened -> removed (ribs cut ~2 cm lateral to costotransverse joints). IDP: Gaeltec needle transducers in the centre of the T4-T5 and T8-T9 discs. Pressure-moment slope from linear regression in positive and negative moment regions separately; mixed-effects estimates. Optotrak pins on left pedicles T4,T5,T8,T9; Euler angles (first rotation = loading direction).
how_to_simulate: Model T1-T12 with rib cage (or ribs removed ~2 cm lateral to costotransverse joints); fix T12, apply pure moment at T1 0 to ±5 Nm in FE, LB, AR.
Superimpose a 400 N follower load (path through vertebral bodies).
Fit slope of nucleus pressure vs moment magnitude (0-5 Nm) at T4-T5 and T8-T9 separately for each direction; and report T4-T5/T8-T9 rotation at 5 Nm.
protocol.notes: Height 1.71±0.11 m, weight 75.8±20.5 kg (analysed specimens). Flexion vs extension slopes differed, and left vs right LB at T4-T5, so analysed separately; AR combined L/R at both levels, LB combined at T8-T9. Stiffened rib cage condition not different from intact (data only in Supplemental Table 1, not available here).

extraction.check_notes: Five values and CIs re-read from Results text; abstract gives 62% and 56% AR, 42% extension (text says 43%), 36-43% LB.

pass_rule.rule: ci95_lo <= model <= ci95_hi (PASS); within 2x CI half-width of estimate (WARN)
